children: Egyptian real estate developer Hyde Park Developments has launched One Hyde Park, a 240-feddan residential project in New Cairo’s Fifth Settlement comprising approximately 8,500 homes, as per an emailed press release.
The development is the company’s ninth project in Egypt and its fourth launch of 2026, expanding its portfolio in East Cairo.

One Hyde Park’s master plan combines residential, educational, recreational, and retail components with open spaces. The project will also include two international schools and a range of services and amenities.

Its residential offering spans standalone villas, twin villas, townhouses, sky villas, garden villas, duplexes, and apartments, including homes overlooking the waterfront. Unit sizes range from 75 to 377 square meters.

The project will also feature six towers that Hyde Park Developments said would be the tallest in the Fifth Settlement. Additional elements include landscaped areas, a main lake for boating and water activities, pedestrian-oriented districts containing shops and commercial services, and an internal shuttle system.

One Hyde Park is directly connected to the Middle Ring Road and provides access to other principal roads in East Cairo. According to the developer, the project is 10 minutes from the American University in Cairo (AUC), seven minutes from Mohamed Naguib Axis, nine minutes from Gamal Abdel Nasser Street, and 18 minutes from El-Sadat Axis.
The company places the development around 25 minutes from Cairo International Airport, 15 minutes from Ain Sokhna Road, and 12 minutes from the New Capital.
Its proximity to Hyde Park New Cairo will give residents access to Ryze Club, which is located within the existing development.
One Hyde Park adds to the company’s East Cairo portfolio, which includes Hyde Park New Cairo, Hyde Park Central, Hyde Park Views, and Hyde Park Terraces.
Hyde Park Developments also owns the West Cairo projects Tawny, Garden Lakes, and Hyde Park Signature, alongside the Seashore development in Ras El Hekma on the North Coast.
The company’s three earlier launches in 2026 were Hyde Park Terraces, the Water Residences phase at Hyde Park Central, and the Shore Residence phase within Seashore.
